goal: A confirmed booking for 13 July. The guest asks on 11 July to move it - 2 days out, inside the 4-day high-season deadline, so it is refused. He then tries to cancel and rebook instead, and learns that costs him the deposit twice: the EUR 200 on the old booking is kept, and it does NOT carry over to a new one. He keeps the original.
policy_refs: policy.md #10 when a change is allowed

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: Hello, we have a table booked for Monday 13 July. Could we move it to Wednesday the 15th instead, same time? Best regards, Jean Dupont

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Dear Mr Dupont, I found your booking - 4 people, dinner, Monday 13 July at 20:30. I am sorry, I cannot move it. In high season a booking can only be changed 4 or more days before the date, and Monday is 2 days away. Your table on 13 July stands exactly as it is.

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: That is a shame. In that case please cancel the 13th and I will make a new booking for the 15th.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: I can do that, but I want you to know the cost first. Cancelling 3 days before or later means the deposit is kept - so the EUR 200 on the 13th would not come back to you. Shall I still cancel it?

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: And if I cancel and rebook the 15th, do I pay a second deposit?

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Yes. A deposit only follows a booking when it is changed, and a change is not possible this close to the date. If you cancel, the EUR 200 stays with the old booking and a new one for the 15th needs its own EUR 200.

turns.speaker: USER
turns.utterance: So cancelling costs me 400 in total. Forget it - leave the Monday booking as it is.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Understood - nothing has changed. Your booking is still 4 people, dinner, Monday 13 July at 20:30, and the EUR 200 you have already paid comes off the bill that night. There is nothing more to pay in advance.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.utterance: Thank you Mr Dupont. Please arrive about 15 minutes before 20:30. We look forward to seeing you on Monday.
